records.subject: InfoComm and Media
records.groupTitle: Internet Usage By Singapore Residents Aged 16 And Over, By Sex
records.title: Internet Usage By Singapore Residents Aged 16 And Over, By Sex, Annual
records.footnote: Internet usage refers to individuals who used the Internet in the past 3 months.  Data from 2020 onwards are based on Singapore residents (i.e. Singapore citizens and permanent residents) aged 16-74 years.  Data prior to 2020 are based on residents of all age groups.  Data are used for SDG 17.8.1 'Proportion of individuals using the Internet'.  Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 17.8.1.
